class.description: ! This class is auxiliary class (data storage) used in ComposeShell. ! It is intended for representing segment of the wire ! (or whole wire). The segment itself is represented by ! ShapeExtend_WireData. In addition, some associated data ! necessary for computations are stored: ! ! * Orientation flag - determines current use of the segment ! and used for parity checking: ! ! TopAbs_FORWARD and TopAbs_REVERSED - says that segment was ! traversed once in the corresponding direction, and hence ! it should be traversed once more in opposite direction; ! ! TopAbs_EXTERNAL - the segment was not yet traversed in any ! direction (i.e. not yet used as boundary) ! ! TopAbs_INTERNAL - the segment was traversed in both ! directions and hence is out of further work. ! ! Segments of initial bounding wires are created with ! orientation REVERSED (for outer wire) or FORWARD (for inner ! wires), and segments of splitting seams - with orientation ! EXTERNAL.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates empty segment.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates segment and initializes it with wire and orientation.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates segment and initializes it with wire and orientation.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clears all fields.

method.name: Load
method.description: Loads wire.

method.name: WireData
method.description: Returns wire.

method.name: Orientation_2
method.description: Sets orientation flag.

method.name: Orientation_1
method.description: Returns orientation flag.

method.name: FirstVertex
method.description: Returns first vertex of the first edge in the wire (no dependence on Orientation()).

method.name: LastVertex
method.description: Returns last vertex of the last edge in the wire (no dependence on Orientation()).

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: Returns True if FirstVertex() == LastVertex()

method.name: NbEdges
method.description: Returns Number of edges in the wire

method.name: Edge
method.description: Returns edge by given index in the wire

method.name: SetEdge
method.description: Replaces edge at index i by new one.

method.name: AddEdge_1
method.description: Insert a new edge with index i and implicitly defined patch indices (indefinite patch). If i==0, edge is inserted at end of wire.

method.name: AddEdge_2
method.description: Insert a new edge with index i and explicitly defined patch indices. If i==0, edge is inserted at end of wire.

method.name: SetPatchIndex
method.description: Set patch indices for edge i.

method.name: DefineIVMax
method.description: Modify minimal or maximal patch index for edge i. The corresponding patch index for that edge is modified so as to satisfy eq. iumin <= myIUMin(i) <= myIUMax(i) <= iumax

method.name: GetPatchIndex
method.description: Returns patch indices for edge i.

method.name: CheckPatchIndex
method.description: Checks patch indices for edge i to satisfy equations IUMin(i) <= IUMax(i) <= IUMin(i)+1
